title: OpenCode Go GPT-5.6 Luna core infrastructure cohort
description: GPT-5.6 Luna attempted three repairs across each of the eight stable core infrastructure incidents through the OpenCode harness and OpenCode Go subscription.

scenario_labels.013-sidekiq-wrong-redis: Sidekiq connected to the wrong Redis

observations: GPT-5.6 Luna completed 22 of 24 evaluated repairs for a 92% pass rate; all 24 trials produced an evaluated result.
Luna completed every attempt for six scenarios. The misses were one of three attempts on the interrupted Discourse deploy and one of three on Nix store disk pressure.
OpenCode Go reports subscription usage rather than metered per-trial provider cost, so public cost is unavailable rather than estimated.
The 1:54 median is directly comparable to other core cohorts only after keeping harness and provider identity visible.
notes: This is an independent OpenCode Go companion cohort using the same core scenario and host-verifier boundary as the canonical OpenRouter release.
Results are intentionally not pooled with Claux/OpenRouter, Vercel AI Gateway, or other harness/provider cohorts.
Failures remain evaluated failures: one agent runtime error and one release-not-converged result.
OpenCode Go does not expose a metered request cost in the adapter output; n/a is the truthful cost value.
reproduction_command: python integrations/host/run_host_matrix.py --benchmark ../replaybook-infra/benchmark-core.toml --models opencode-go/gpt-5.6-luna --reasoning-efforts high --agent-provider opencode-go --agent-adapter integrations/host/adapters/opencode.sh --agent-payload ~/.opencode/bin/opencode --agent-env-file <prepared-opencode-env> --agent-name opencode --concurrency 1 --base-port 28600
